minor.issue: Successive /preview polls returned different signed URLs (poll 1: 5173-lltvqusxwyxkkxah..., poll 2: 5173-zi0mh58z0tfor0f7..., poll 3: 5173-blck9rrrjfxrxw5v...). Each call to sandbox.create_signed_preview_url() mints a fresh URL. Not broken (all still work), but preview_url in Mongo gets overwritten on each poll and any client that cached an earlier URL keeps working only until expiry (3600s). Consider caching the signed URL in Mongo and only refreshing when close to expiry.

Org disk quota is 30GiB and had accumulated 10 stale sandboxes (5 from other/user-workspace processes, 5 from prior coding tests) causing `Total disk limit exceeded` errors when the first test run tried to create new sandboxes. This blocks ALL sandbox creation until an admin cleans up. Consider (1) auto-deleting sandbox on project delete (already done) AND on project sandbox_status=error, (2) a cron/heartbeat that archives stopped sandboxes older than N hours, (3) surface quota errors clearly in UI (currently only in project.error which is not shown).

critical_code_review_comments: daytona_service.preview_status: signed URL fallback logic looks correct (try create_signed_preview_url first, then get_preview_link). Good.
coding.py SCAFFOLDS: templates are pure dicts injected via write_file — clean and easy to extend. Consider externalising to JSON files if the list grows.
coding.py create_project silently falls back to 'react-vite' if template is not in SCAFFOLDS. Reasonable, but returning 400 for an unknown template id would surface UI bugs faster.

daytona_service.start_dev_server: relies on package.json presence to choose npm run dev vs npx serve. That's correct for the 4 built-in templates, but 'node' template's package.json has scripts.dev='node index.js' which listens on 5173 too — verified to work. Static template will use `npx serve` — untested here but expected.

CodeWorkspace.jsx firstFile fallback still says `firstFile(t) || 'src/App.jsx'` — if tree is truly empty this will still try to open App.jsx and toast an error. Minor edge case (empty tree is unlikely).

context_for_next_testing_agent: This iteration verified 3 bug fixes only. The Daytona org disk quota is 30GiB total — if the next iteration adds more coding tests, run `python /app/scripts/daytona_cleanup.py --delete` first (uses DAYTONA_API_KEY from backend/.env) to reap stale sandboxes. Backend URL: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL was NOT set in the container env; conftest.py handles that via a default in-code, but shell users must `export REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=https://ai-manager-auto.preview.emergentagent.com` before pytest. Signed preview URLs look like https://<port>-<token>.daytonaproxy01.eu.
rca_of_the_issue: Original bug (from problem statement): backend used sb.get_preview_link() which returned an *unsigned* URL protected by Daytona's auth0 tenant, so any iframe or curl without auth0 session got redirected. Fix in daytona_service.preview_status: call sb.create_signed_preview_url(PORT, expires_in_seconds=3600) FIRST which returns a URL with a signed token embedded; fall back to get_preview_link only if signing fails. Verified: signed URL returns HTTP 200 + real HTML with 0 redirects, no auth0 in body/chain.
